name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Study

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmed enrollment for the purpose of study at a Ukrainian educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to an accredited Ukrainian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Valid passport (or stateless person ID) with a D visa, a Ukrainian translation of the passport's personal-data pages, and a medical insurance policy.

sources.title: State Migration Service of Ukraine (dmsu.gov.ua), official English page -- Issuance of Temporary Residence Permit: study category, universal documentation requirements (D visa, translated passport, medical insurance, fee schedule), 15-working-day processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ukraine). Ukraine's temporary residence permit system has 12 qualifying categories under one legal framework -- this file, ua_work_permit.json, ua_investor_residence.json, and ua_family_reunification.json all draw on the same tier-1 dmsu.gov.ua page for their category-specific detail, differing mainly in the category-specific documentation and validity period. pr_after_months is left null since Ukraine's permanent residence (see ua_permanent_residence.json) is gated behind a separate quota-based 'immigration permit,' not a fixed years-of-temporary-residence clock -- a student does not automatically become PR-eligible after any set number of years, disclosed here rather than assumed. leads_to_citizenship (60 months) reflects ua_citizenship_naturalisation.json's standard 5-year residence figure.
